strings.item.25.0.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.0.name: Perfect, you smell strong!
strings.item.25.1.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.1.name: Your friends are incredible!
strings.item.25.10.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.10.name: I'm not running!
strings.item.25.100.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.100.name: So you were only warming up just now, were you?
strings.item.25.10000.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.10000.name: Show me how tough you are by beating me!
strings.item.25.10004.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.10004.name: What's wrong?  I haven't even gotten serious yet.
strings.item.25.10009.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.10009.name: I am already at a level  no mortal can even dream of reaching!
strings.item.25.10010.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.10010.name: Ugyagyagyaoo!!
strings.item.25.10011.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.10011.name: No matter who I'm up against...victory will be mine!
strings.item.25.10012.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.10012.name: KSHAAAAAH!
strings.item.25.101.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.101.name: T-That's impossible!
strings.item.25.102.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.102.name: You're pretty good.
strings.item.25.103.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.103.name: Hoowee!
strings.item.25.104.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.104.name: That's a bold statement.
strings.item.25.105.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.105.name: I toldja.
strings.item.25.106.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.106.name: Then you are officially dead!!!!
strings.item.25.107.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.107.name: I'm the most powerful being in the universe!
strings.item.25.108.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.108.name: Yoo-hoo!
strings.item.25.109.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.109.name: You're Not the Only One Who Can Do That!
strings.item.25.11.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.11.name: I-If only I achieved Perfect Form!
strings.item.25.110.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.110.name: Are you seriously crying?!
strings.item.25.111.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.111.name: Never! I'll never give up! They're counting on me!
strings.item.25.112.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.112.name: The real danger is my fist!
strings.item.25.113.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.113.name: The power coursing through me is exceptional. Glorious. Absolute.
strings.item.25.114.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.114.name: For the Good of the Cosmos... For Creation...!
strings.item.25.115.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.115.name: Wait, wait! Hold on!
strings.item.25.118.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.118.name: I made up my mind that when I grew up, I would do anything to track you down and beat you to a bloody pulp!
strings.item.25.12.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.12.name: You've got me...  I might just lose this one...
strings.item.25.120.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.120.name: This is me at my current full power.
strings.item.25.121.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.121.name: Hurry and drain your tears so we can fight.
strings.item.25.122.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.122.name: I'm interested in the extinction of every living creature on this planet.
strings.item.25.123.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.123.name: I won't forget this, kid! I'll be back!
strings.item.25.124.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.124.name: *Grin*
strings.item.25.125.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.125.name: Run along, Buu. Or shall I turn you into stone?
strings.item.25.126.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.126.name: But he seems even stronger.
strings.item.25.127.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.127.name: I have a gut feeling we'll see each other again!
strings.item.25.128.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.128.name: You're strong, I'll give you that...but you've chosen the wrong opponent.
strings.item.25.129.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.129.name: Wow, I can't believe it! You ARE fast!
strings.item.25.13.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.13.name: Whoa...
strings.item.25.130.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.130.name: Hey! That's not fair, Gohan!
strings.item.25.131.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.131.name: *pant* *pant* Guess I'll go... Super.
strings.item.25.132.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.132.name: You didn't say you'd hit back, Dad.
strings.item.25.133.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.133.name: Aghh... agh.. ugh....
strings.item.25.134.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.134.name: You don't want to make me upset. One little shock could set me off!
strings.item.25.135.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.135.name: Nah. He's tough, but he's not unbeatable.
strings.item.25.136.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.136.name: And then...tell me what has more meaning than your own strength!
strings.item.25.137.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.137.name: And I'd have to say it feels pretty good.
strings.item.25.139.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.139.name: This really is a pleasure, Goku.  Having you of all people seeing and rating my power.
strings.item.25.14.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.14.name: Not bad!
strings.item.25.140.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.140.name: You've helped refine my palette and made me that much stronger.
strings.item.25.141.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.141.name: See, Gohan! Even the lowlifes agree.
strings.item.25.142.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.142.name: I am Saiyaman #1!
strings.item.25.143.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.143.name: Saiyaman #2 at your service!
strings.item.25.145.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.145.name: It'll be beyond any of us.  It'll be the end of the world.
strings.item.25.146.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.146.name: You weren't using full power.
strings.item.25.148.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.148.name: Buu, I'm a man of courtesy.
strings.item.25.149.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.149.name: It's over, Janemba. I've come for you!
strings.item.25.15.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.15.name: Heck, I'm sure I'll pass you up!
strings.item.25.150.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.150.name: I'm not "funny" and there's no way I'll be friends with you!
strings.item.25.151.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.151.name: You keep deluding yourself.
strings.item.25.152.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.152.name: You were baiting me into dropping my guard!
strings.item.25.153.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.153.name: Everyone here thinks of you as a villain now.
strings.item.25.154.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.154.name: Imagine if I'd let it hit me... tsk...  wouldn't be much left of me, eh...?
strings.item.25.155.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.155.name: I'll give you some credit for that one!
strings.item.25.156.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.156.name: These figures are most unreliable.
strings.item.25.158.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.158.name: I believe we have some unfinished business.
strings.item.25.159.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.159.name: What's the matter? Where is all that vigor you had before?
strings.item.25.16.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.16.name: I give up.
strings.item.25.160.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.160.name: It seems you have made your decision.
strings.item.25.161.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.161.name: The fighters who hoped to challenge me...have already failed.
strings.item.25.163.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.163.name: I think this is all the power I need.
strings.item.25.164.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.164.name: That's justice!
strings.item.25.165.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.165.name: Ha! You're using guesswork to deal with my speed.
strings.item.25.166.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.166.name: Eheheh...
strings.item.25.167.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.167.name: I'm a lot more vulnerable when you're there with me!
strings.item.25.168.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.168.name: You know you can't win! You can't destroy what I really am!
strings.item.25.169.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.169.name: I can't sense his energy...
strings.item.25.170.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.170.name: So that counts as landing a blow, right?
strings.item.25.171.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.171.name: You hit me! You hit me!!
strings.item.25.173.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.173.name: You're as big of a fool as ever!
strings.item.25.174.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.174.name: You're not half bad!
strings.item.25.175.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.175.name: Thank you very much!
strings.item.25.176.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.176.name: You truly do love fighting, don't you?
strings.item.25.177.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.177.name: Hahahahahaha!
strings.item.25.178.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.178.name: Uh uh uh!
strings.item.25.179.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.179.name: His attacks are so fast... so powerful...!
strings.item.25.18.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.18.name: Alright then. Thanks for your business.
strings.item.25.180.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.180.name: You're not protecting my ego...
strings.item.25.181.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.181.name: Curse you... Look what you've done!
strings.item.25.183.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.183.name: It's obvious my minions were no match for your level of skill...
strings.item.25.184.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.184.name: If you were more like me, you could overcome anything even pain.
strings.item.25.185.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.185.name: The rage I now feel for letting you get the upper hand in our battle...
strings.item.25.186.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.186.name: My strength surpasses my own understanding!
strings.item.25.187.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.187.name: Thank you for saving smiles like these.
strings.item.25.188.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.188.name: I should have saved more...
strings.item.25.189.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.189.name: Thanks so much, everyone, for everything.
strings.item.25.190.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.190.name: Guess what, your move? I figured it out.
strings.item.25.191.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.191.name: Until next time. I'll be ready!
strings.item.25.192.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.192.name: On to the next target...
strings.item.25.193.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.193.name: Your obsession with battle is quite profound...
strings.item.25.194.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.194.name: What have those rugrats done?!
strings.item.25.195.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.195.name: Prepare yourself for the chewiest and fluffiest octopus you've ever tasted!
strings.item.25.196.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.196.name: Hya!!
strings.item.25.198.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.198.name: I let my guard down...
strings.item.25.199.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.199.name: This fight has been instructive. I do appreciate the lesson.
strings.item.25.2.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.2.name: Great training session!
strings.item.25.200.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.200.name: Just don't get gushy on us.
strings.item.25.20000.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.20000.name: That was one hell of a fight. Quite satisfying, I must say...
strings.item.25.20001.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.20001.name: Well done. But seems my level of power is beyond you.
strings.item.25.20002.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.20002.name: This is everything I've got!
strings.item.25.20003.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.20003.name: Here...!! Have it...!!
strings.item.25.20004.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.20004.name: Defy the gods and be punished!
strings.item.25.20005.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.20005.name: You challenge me? Don't make me laugh!
strings.item.25.20006.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.20006.name: This fight's far from over!
strings.item.25.20007.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.20007.name: I wouldn't underestimate a god if I were you!
strings.item.25.20008.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.20008.name: The battle ends here!
strings.item.25.20009.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.20009.name: GAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!!!
strings.item.25.20010.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.20010.name: I won't give up no matter what!
strings.item.25.20011.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.20011.name: I don't care who we're up against.  There's no way we'll lose.
strings.item.25.20012.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.20012.name: Hope you got a good look  at the power of our Fusion!
strings.item.25.20013.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.20013.name: - Looking good out there, Vegeta.  - Hmph, you're no slouch yourself.
strings.item.25.20014.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.20014.name: You're pretty good, Frieza.  Of course.  I am Frieza, Emperor of the Universe!
strings.item.25.20015.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.20015.name: Let's fight it out till the end!
strings.item.25.20016.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.20016.name: I am the supreme master of this universe!
strings.item.25.20017.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.20017.name: I won't let you destroy Earth!
strings.item.25.20018.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.20018.name: Can you guess my power level? Five hundred...thirty thousand.
strings.item.25.20019.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.20019.name: This is Super Saiyan Blue. Don't you forget it.
strings.item.25.20020.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.20020.name: This is my true form!
strings.item.25.20021.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.20021.name: I knew we could do it!  Hmph... Was there ever any doubt?
strings.item.25.20022.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.20022.name: SPECIAL BEAM CANNOOOON!
strings.item.25.202.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.203.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.203.name: Ah...!
strings.item.25.204.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.204.name: Now you will know the horror!!!
strings.item.25.205.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.205.name: Three hard punches and all you got is a bloody nose... I have to admit I'm impressed.
strings.item.25.206.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.206.name: Actually, your little treatment took care of a crick in my neck that's been bothering me.
strings.item.25.207.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.207.name: I don't need your prostrations, mortal. I just need you dead!
strings.item.25.208.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.208.name: That is the duty of a true god.
strings.item.25.209.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.209.name: Sorry to be rude, but you left yourself completely open!
strings.item.25.21.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.21.name: If that was your best, I'm disappointed...
strings.item.25.210.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.210.name: Damn, you're awesome!
strings.item.25.211.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.211.name: This is the sweetest fight I've ever had!
strings.item.25.212.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.212.name: I cannot allow you to get away with the trauma you've caused to innocent people.
strings.item.25.213.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.213.name: His energy is amazing!
strings.item.25.214.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.214.name: Let's go!
strings.item.25.215.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.215.name: Actually, there is one word that comes to mind!
strings.item.25.216.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.216.name: Impressive.
strings.item.25.217.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.217.name: Groaaagh?!
strings.item.25.218.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.218.name: Was that...?!
strings.item.25.219.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.219.name: But how? The two of us have always been on par with each other!
strings.item.25.22.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.22.name: Must be a trick...
strings.item.25.220.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.220.name: I do believe this Earth might have taught our friend a thing or two...
strings.item.25.223.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.223.name: That all? Or do you want more?
strings.item.25.224.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.224.name: I haven't been this excited about a fight in a long time!
strings.item.25.225.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.225.name: What... What just happened? I thought I had control!
strings.item.25.226.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.226.name: Luck has nothing to do with it!
strings.item.25.227.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.227.name: AAAAAHHH!!
strings.item.25.228.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.228.name: It's been quite a long time, eh?
strings.item.25.229.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.229.name: Believe what you want. I believe in what I can see and touch.
strings.item.25.230.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.230.name: I am emperor of the Universe!
strings.item.25.231.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.231.name: I'll shatter through my limits! In my own way! On my own terms!
strings.item.25.233.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.233.name: This fight is over.
strings.item.25.234.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.234.name: Justice and evil... I have moved beyond that binary now.
strings.item.25.235.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.235.name: It would be so easy for me to expunge your soul from existence...
strings.item.25.236.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.236.name: I'm not falling for the same trick twice!
strings.item.25.237.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.237.name: I can't see!!
strings.item.25.238.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.238.name: That was nothing but a dirty move!
strings.item.25.239.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.239.name: That's the plan!
strings.item.25.24.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.24.name: Come on, let's get along!
strings.item.25.240.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.240.name: Master Shallooot!  Go get 'em!
strings.item.25.241.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.241.name: Nooooooo!!!!
strings.item.25.242.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.242.name: D-Damn it! Where the hell's that one been hiding all this time...?
strings.item.25.243.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.243.name: Nappa! Dodge it!
strings.item.25.244.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.244.name: I may have pushed my body a bit past its limit...
strings.item.25.245.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.245.name: He's so much stronger than me...
strings.item.25.246.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.247.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.247.name: Yup, looks like 6 it is!
strings.item.25.248.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.248.name: This soil should do nicely!
strings.item.25.249.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.249.name: Gyaa!!!
strings.item.25.25.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.25.name: Look at the pretty fireworks!
strings.item.25.250.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.250.name: Wrooooooahahaha!!!!
strings.item.25.251.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.251.name: Something amuse you?
strings.item.25.252.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.252.name: Aaaaaaagh...!!!!
strings.item.25.253.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.253.name: Why don't you wake up?!
strings.item.25.254.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.254.name: All right, then! We'll play by your rules!
strings.item.25.255.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.255.name: Gohan, what are you doing?!
strings.item.25.256.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.256.name: I'm disappointed in myself.
strings.item.25.257.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.257.name: How could you just eat the dragon ball?!
strings.item.25.258.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.258.name: Behold... One body with the power of seven!
strings.item.25.259.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.259.name: You don't believe in anything but yourself, and I won't let you win!
strings.item.25.26.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.26.name: I am Super Vegeta!
strings.item.25.260.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.260.name: I don't give a damn about you or your so-called justice!
strings.item.25.261.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.261.name: Thanks, everyone.
strings.item.25.262.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.262.name: That won't work!
strings.item.25.263.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.263.name: I'm beginning to wonder if you're indestructible.
strings.item.25.264.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.264.name: That was good.
strings.item.25.265.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.265.name: It's over...
strings.item.25.266.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.266.name: Just what's going on here?
strings.item.25.267.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.267.name: Just get outta here already.
strings.item.25.268.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.268.name: I am not about to give up!
strings.item.25.269.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.269.name: He really is only using about fifty percent of his maximum power!
strings.item.25.27.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.27.name: Are you talking about Krillin?!
strings.item.25.270.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.270.name: You very nearly brought the mighty Frieza down...
strings.item.25.271.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.271.name: I advise against placing too much stock in your escape...
strings.item.25.273.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.273.name: They can't have any strength left!
strings.item.25.274.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.274.name: Until next time! We shall meet again!
strings.item.25.275.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.275.name: I need a nap pronto!
strings.item.25.276.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.276.name: You may be willing to commit taboos,  but this god is staying out of it.
strings.item.25.277.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.277.name: You really are incredible.
strings.item.25.278.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.278.name: I won't back down now.
strings.item.25.279.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.279.name: How rude of me.  My fist slipped right into your chest.
strings.item.25.28.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.28.name: Everything changes now!
strings.item.25.280.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.280.name: So tell me.  How do you like this newly polished Gold?
strings.item.25.281.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.281.name: Are these terms agreeable to you?
strings.item.25.283.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.283.name: This fight's not over yet!
strings.item.25.284.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.284.name: This is our power!
strings.item.25.285.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.285.name: Wroaaaaahhhh!!
strings.item.25.286.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.286.name: Fight with all you have!  Bring honor to yourself and our kind!
strings.item.25.287.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.287.name: The Saiyans will never perish!
strings.item.25.288.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.288.name: You call that a punch?
strings.item.25.289.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.29.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.29.name: That was fun... See ya!
strings.item.25.290.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.290.name: Looks like all hell's breaking loose, huh!
strings.item.25.291.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.291.name: I am absolutely Krillin' it today!
strings.item.25.292.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.292.name: Let's see if they got me close enough!
strings.item.25.293.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.293.name: I have to thank you.  This battle made me even stronger.
strings.item.25.294.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.294.name: I'll always stay true to that belief!!
strings.item.25.295.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.295.name: No, I can't beat them...  Not like this.
strings.item.25.296.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.296.name: My power's gone up...  but these bulky muscles  make it hard to move very fast.
strings.item.25.297.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.297.name: All the raw power in the universe  won't do me any good if I can't catch my opponent...
strings.item.25.298.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.298.name: Why...can't I hit them?!
strings.item.25.3.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.3.name: You ARE number one!!
strings.item.25.30.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.30.name: Thank you very much!
strings.item.25.300.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.300.name: You trashed my favorite shirt!
strings.item.25.301.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.301.name: You're getting to be a real bother!
strings.item.25.302.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.302.name: Now that's more like it!  I knew you had it in you!
strings.item.25.303.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.303.name: Honestly, you're going on like a village idiot!
strings.item.25.306.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.306.name: You've become too strong!
strings.item.25.308.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.308.name: Just because things are peaceful now is no excuse to get lazy.
strings.item.25.31.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.31.name: Heh heh! You're pretty strong! Let's go again!
strings.item.25.310.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.310.name: A paltry ten times gravity?  I can barely even feel it...
strings.item.25.311.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.311.name: What are you? Immortal?
strings.item.25.312.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.312.name: Ahhhhahahahaha!!
strings.item.25.314.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.314.name: ARGGHHHH!!!
strings.item.25.315.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.315.name: I will do the honors of overseeing your destruction.
strings.item.25.318.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.318.name: You really do care!
strings.item.25.319.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.319.name: You said you were gonna hold back!
strings.item.25.32.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.32.name: Nice! I wanna fight you again!
strings.item.25.320.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.320.name: Pretending to be weak is tough!
strings.item.25.321.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.321.name: You're the best!  Thanks!
strings.item.25.322.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.322.name: Just soaking it all in.  This is great.  It doesn't get any better than this.
strings.item.25.323.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.323.name: This is going to be special!
strings.item.25.324.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.324.name: If we attack now, we'll die.
strings.item.25.325.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.325.name: No, there's no need. When there's Fusion!
strings.item.25.326.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.326.name: You and I are partners.
strings.item.25.327.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.327.name: I can feel the power of the underworld pouring over me...
strings.item.25.33.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.33.name: All that fighting got me hungry! Let's go grab something to eat!
strings.item.25.330.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.330.name: You're in for a hard truth...
strings.item.25.331.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.331.name: I'm so excited I could just explode.
strings.item.25.332.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.332.name: You really thought you'd catch me with that trap?
strings.item.25.333.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.333.name: One beyond that!
strings.item.25.334.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.334.name: I am the great destroyer! The taker of life!
strings.item.25.335.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.335.name: I am the supreme master of this Universe!
strings.item.25.336.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.336.name: If you wish not to fight back, I understand...  But I am going to destroy this planet no matter what.
strings.item.25.337.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.337.name: You want a handicap?  Is that another word for a coffin?
strings.item.25.338.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.338.name: Where do you think you're going?
strings.item.25.339.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.339.name: This is the power of mortals!
strings.item.25.34.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.34.name: What kind of training are you doing?! You're crazy strong!
strings.item.25.340.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.340.name: Are you gonna lie there all day or are we gonna fight!
strings.item.25.341.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.341.name: Don't underestimate mortals.  And especially not a Saiyan!
strings.item.25.342.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.342.name: Haa...! Haa...!
strings.item.25.343.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.343.name: It's time to show them divine perfection made whole.
strings.item.25.344.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.344.name: HAAAAAH!
strings.item.25.345.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.345.name: How truly magnificent!
strings.item.25.346.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.346.name: This one's built tough.
strings.item.25.347.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.347.name: I suppose being an Android gave me an inside track.
strings.item.25.348.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.348.name: You're a lot tougher than I thought.
strings.item.25.35.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.35.name: Awesome!
strings.item.25.350.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.350.name: Of all the people I've fought who've taken that  many of my attacks, you're the only one to live.
strings.item.25.351.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.351.name: You showing your cards tells me that you're young.
strings.item.25.353.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.353.name: I'm afraid I've used up most of my magic...
strings.item.25.354.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.354.name: Hehe... That's rich!
strings.item.25.355.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.355.name: Phew...! Let's do that again sometime!
strings.item.25.356.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.356.name: *Psshhhh*
strings.item.25.357.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.357.name: *smirk*
strings.item.25.358.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.358.name: Like the view?  Don't get too used to it; you won't be here long.
strings.item.25.359.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.359.name: Then why aren't you moving?  You're bluffing!
strings.item.25.36.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.36.name: He was really that powerful...?
strings.item.25.360.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.360.name: Uwaah?!
strings.item.25.361.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.361.name: I'm starting to get a handle on it.
strings.item.25.363.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.363.name: I have forged a new instrument with which to destroy you.
strings.item.25.364.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.364.name: My might will be unrivaled too!
strings.item.25.365.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.365.name: His wound just healed itself!
strings.item.25.366.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.366.name: Is there nothing more I can do?
strings.item.25.368.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.368.name: The perfect body. The perfect power... Truly marvelous.
strings.item.25.369.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.369.name: I think I bit off more than I could chew...
strings.item.25.37.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.37.name: You picked the wrong opponent!
strings.item.25.371.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.371.name: Stay alive...Vegeta.
strings.item.25.372.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.372.name: Ha! ...Don't worry 'bout me.
strings.item.25.373.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.373.name: I'm not...through with you!
strings.item.25.374.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.374.name: Ho ho ho!!
strings.item.25.375.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.375.name: Sorry about that...  Didn't mean to leave you like that.
strings.item.25.376.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.376.name: As long as you hold up your end of the bargain,  I'll hold up mine.  You should know that better than anyone.
strings.item.25.377.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.377.name: Will you keep your word or won't you?
strings.item.25.378.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.378.name: That sickening naiveté of yours is what I quite despise most.  But for my own self-interest, I should probably thank you.
strings.item.25.379.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.379.name: HAAAAA!!!
strings.item.25.38.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.38.name: N-Not bad, I guess!
strings.item.25.380.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.380.name: The power of trust...
strings.item.25.39.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.39.name: I will never lose!!
strings.item.25.390.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.390.name: Hrnng!
strings.item.25.391.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.391.name: When they said there were some insanely strong guys here, they weren't kidding.
strings.item.25.392.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.392.name: This can't be happening!!!
strings.item.25.393.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.393.name: Well, maybe humorous is the wrong word. Thrilling, perhaps... Yes, that's it.
strings.item.25.394.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.394.name: It's like something straight out of a nightmare!
strings.item.25.395.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.395.name: What are you?!
strings.item.25.396.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.396.name: Ugyaaaaah!!
strings.item.25.397.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.397.name: Now you're fighting dirty... Just the way I like it.
strings.item.25.398.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.398.name: It's time...! To...! Go!
strings.item.25.399.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.399.name: You really are a ghost magician!
strings.item.25.4.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.4.name: Y...You've got me... Got me good...
strings.item.25.40.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.40.name: Well... this is fun!
strings.item.25.400.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.400.name: That was fun!
strings.item.25.403.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.403.name: I'm sorry I wasted money.
strings.item.25.404.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.404.name: I wanted to thank you... You saved...my existence.
strings.item.25.405.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.405.name: Old bones still have some kick.
strings.item.25.407.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.407.name: It took me fifty years to develop that technique...
strings.item.25.408.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.408.name: Grrr...
strings.item.25.409.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.409.name: Uwraaaaah!!
strings.item.25.41.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.41.name: Come on, Laugh!
strings.item.25.411.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.411.name: Hehe...
strings.item.25.412.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.412.name: Not bad, horn-head!
strings.item.25.413.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.413.name: I won't let you go any further!
strings.item.25.414.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.414.name: Wow! Incredible!
strings.item.25.415.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.415.name: I'll surpass everyone!
strings.item.25.416.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.416.name: There's no doubt. You really are incredible...
strings.item.25.417.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.417.name: What's that gigantic energy that just showed up?
strings.item.25.418.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.418.name: Any fool could see you've been the strongest.
strings.item.25.419.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.419.name: Now you can finally see my all.
strings.item.25.42.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.42.name: Fwa ha ha ha!
strings.item.25.420.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.420.name: It's up to you, Kakarot.  Don't you fail, too.
strings.item.25.421.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.421.name: That's the best I could do.
strings.item.25.422.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.422.name: Hmph. Your strategy worked.
strings.item.25.424.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.424.name: Attention, ladies and gentlemen...  If you can hear my voice, run!
strings.item.25.426.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.426.name: I can tell you've trained hard these last three years.
strings.item.25.427.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.427.name: Yes!!! I am the champion!
strings.item.25.428.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.428.name: I must admit you've surprised me.  Your moves and techniques are adequate...
strings.item.25.429.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.429.name: Ehehehehe... That's better... I'm done.
strings.item.25.43.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.43.name: Aaaaghh!
strings.item.25.430.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.430.name: Now that's what I call self-improvement! Good work!
strings.item.25.432.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.432.name: You do what it takes to survive, got it?
strings.item.25.433.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.433.name: Good-bye...
strings.item.25.434.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.434.name: We'll see about that...
strings.item.25.435.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.435.name: Thanks to the citizens of the universe!
strings.item.25.436.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.436.name: All of the Shadow Dragons are gone!
strings.item.25.437.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.437.name: I'm the end of the road for you, Jack!
strings.item.25.438.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.438.name: You failed the grade as a kamikaze...
strings.item.25.439.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.439.name: Haven't you learned yet? It will only make me stronger!
strings.item.25.44.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.44.name: Ginyu Rock-Paper-Scissors (Paper)
strings.item.25.440.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.440.name: Ow! Dad, what are you doing?
strings.item.25.441.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.441.name: I could've finished him, and I didn't!
strings.item.25.442.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.442.name: I'd have given anything for a chance to do it over again... Now I get one.
strings.item.25.443.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.443.name: Are you not taking this seriously?!
strings.item.25.444.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.444.name: So...did you like that?
strings.item.25.445.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.445.name: Rrrraaaaaggghh!!
strings.item.25.446.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.446.name: Electrified! ...That is the only word I can find to describe this!
strings.item.25.447.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.447.name: Oh, yes! At last! Revenge is ours!
strings.item.25.448.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.448.name: Another costume change for the weakling?
strings.item.25.449.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.449.name: HUWROOOAAAGH!
strings.item.25.45.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.45.name: Ginyu Rock-Paper-Scissors (Rock)
strings.item.25.450.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.450.name: You're not...! Who are you?!
strings.item.25.451.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.451.name: Was that too much? I'm still getting used to this...
strings.item.25.452.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.452.name: Why?! This shouldn't be happening!
strings.item.25.453.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.453.name: Wha...What in...the heck...was that?!
strings.item.25.454.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.454.name: Who...Who are you? Whaddya want?!
strings.item.25.455.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.455.name: Waaaaaahh!!
strings.item.25.456.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.456.name: How sweet...does that victory taste now...?
strings.item.25.457.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.457.name: This ends now...and you're gonna pay!
strings.item.25.458.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.458.name: That's some strength. I'd be more impressed if you knew what to do with it, though.
strings.item.25.459.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.459.name: Alright, then. Let's get this over with. Come on!
strings.item.25.46.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.46.name: Ginyu Rock-Paper-Scissors (Scissors)
strings.item.25.460.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.461.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.461.name: Hurry, Gokuuuu!! We need your heeeeeelp!!
strings.item.25.462.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.462.name: Hey! How about that? He's not Slow-ku after all!
strings.item.25.463.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.463.name: Fusion's the only chance we have to beat this guy.
strings.item.25.464.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.464.name: Whew...
strings.item.25.465.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.465.name: Uwa... Agh...
strings.item.25.466.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.466.name: Damn it...
strings.item.25.467.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.467.name: Should putting this on make me feel stronger...? 'Cause it's just making me feel silly.
strings.item.25.468.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.468.name: Thanks...
strings.item.25.469.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.469.name: I use your energy to track your movement. I could fight you with my eyes shut.
strings.item.25.47.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.47.name: That was cool!! Teach me how, huh, will ya?!
strings.item.25.470.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.470.name: We're counting on you!
strings.item.25.472.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.472.name: It's a level of strength I can't reach on my own.
strings.item.25.473.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.473.name: Heh-heh, that's pretty much it.
strings.item.25.474.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.474.name: Yes, good. Now you're getting it.
strings.item.25.475.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.475.name: I'll just have to come back another time and finish destroying the rest.
strings.item.25.476.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.476.name: I'm glad I wasn't too late.
strings.item.25.477.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.477.name: You don't stand a chance.
strings.item.25.478.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.478.name: You have?!
strings.item.25.479.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.479.name: I have the power to destroy you now.
strings.item.25.48.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.48.name: RRRO-----R
strings.item.25.480.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.480.name: That's better...
strings.item.25.481.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.481.name: Impossible... How did he do that?!
strings.item.25.482.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.482.name: You know what the best part is? I've been holding out on you!
strings.item.25.483.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.483.name: Agghh... Eghh...
strings.item.25.484.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.484.name: Give me...power!
strings.item.25.485.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.485.name: If you think you can stand in our way...you're dead wrong.
strings.item.25.486.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.486.name: We outshadow every fighter in the known universe.
strings.item.25.487.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.487.name: Hrm!
strings.item.25.488.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.488.name: You'd best not underestimate us!
strings.item.25.489.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.489.name: This is...the real deal!
strings.item.25.49.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.49.name: Not too bad for an old codger...
strings.item.25.490.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.490.name: You see? Anger increases your strength...
strings.item.25.491.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.491.name: Check. Mate.
strings.item.25.492.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.492.name: Kakarooot!!!
strings.item.25.493.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.493.name: FUHAHAHAHAHAHA!!
strings.item.25.494.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.494.name: So, you're the monster terrorizing the village?
strings.item.25.495.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.495.name: Those fancy moves won't work on me!
strings.item.25.496.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.496.name: I've been training harder than you could ever imagine.
strings.item.25.497.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.497.name: You will become my new disciple.
strings.item.25.498.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.498.name: What is this? You're as strong as I thought!
strings.item.25.499.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.499.name: Yeah! Ha ha ha!
strings.item.25.5.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.5.name: Heh! Now I'm impressed...
strings.item.25.50.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.50.name: Must you be so rebellious, dear?
strings.item.25.500.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.500.name: Oh, yeah. I'll make you pay...
strings.item.25.501.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.501.name: Hee-hee...
strings.item.25.502.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.502.name: There is a part of me that you will never control...  I carry within me the pride of a prince!
strings.item.25.503.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.503.name: Hmph, I guess even you can be taken by surprise...
strings.item.25.504.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.504.name: No matter what, you have to get through this...  For all of our sakes.
strings.item.25.505.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.505.name: You fool! Here in hell, our bodies are immortal!
strings.item.25.506.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.506.name: Wh...Why...?!
strings.item.25.507.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.507.name: Your divine power's not looking so "wondrous" now!
strings.item.25.508.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.508.name: You can't even keep up with me, can you?!
strings.item.25.509.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.509.name: For a lowly animal, you've come quite far...
strings.item.25.51.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.51.name: He sure gave us a good show!
strings.item.25.510.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.510.name: Now watch as I rise to an even greater level of power still!
strings.item.25.511.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.511.name: I'm gonna show you a level beyond that.
strings.item.25.512.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.512.name: This guy's good. After all this, I've still underestimated the depths of his power.
strings.item.25.513.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.513.name: I don't mean this as an insult...but you're weird.
strings.item.25.514.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.514.name: I wouldn't be able to forgive myself if anything happened to you.
strings.item.25.515.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.515.name: I can't just sneak around while this is going on!
strings.item.25.517.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.517.name: He's dangerous today. Something's got him fired up.
strings.item.25.518.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.518.name: Stare in awe. I am justice incarnate!
strings.item.25.519.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.519.name: The great utopia will rise from the ashes!
strings.item.25.52.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.52.name: Hey, when I've trained more and gotten stronger, you wanna fight me again?
strings.item.25.520.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.520.name: Your team is clever...
strings.item.25.522.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.522.name: Prowling through my thoughts?
strings.item.25.523.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.523.name: How could I have failed so completely?
strings.item.25.524.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.524.name: Please, forgive me for barging in...
strings.item.25.525.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.525.name: Ah. Oh, well!
strings.item.25.526.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.526.name: Why didn't I eat a Senzu bean when he gave me the chance?
strings.item.25.527.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.527.name: These little things are stronger than they look!
strings.item.25.528.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.528.name: I won't have any use for a Senzu bean.
strings.item.25.529.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.529.name: With all the power I've gained, I should be destroying him...
strings.item.25.53.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.53.name: Heh!
strings.item.25.530.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.530.name: This is what you might refer to as a happy accident.
strings.item.25.531.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.531.name: This is goodbye!!
strings.item.25.532.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.533.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.533.name: Heheheheh...  I didn't kill you, though you should've died...
strings.item.25.534.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.534.name: You've improved a little. You're no longer tripping over your own feet...
strings.item.25.535.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.535.name: What respect I had for you has now turned to pity! You have no honor!
strings.item.25.536.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.536.name: That's it, go on prattling.
strings.item.25.537.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.537.name: Its lethal force incinerates anything it touches!
strings.item.25.538.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.538.name: I don't believe it! It can't be...!
strings.item.25.539.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.539.name: You insolent wretch!
strings.item.25.54.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.54.name: Phew!
strings.item.25.540.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.540.name: That's more like it. I destroyed you...
strings.item.25.541.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.541.name: Unbelievable...  How could we, the Demon Clan, be beaten by you?!
strings.item.25.542.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.542.name: I guess you could say I sense your power level!
strings.item.25.543.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.543.name: Hahaha! I gotcha!
strings.item.25.544.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.544.name: Danger is the noisy next-door neighbor of security.
strings.item.25.546.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.546.name: But anyone who tries to hurt my friends...is gonna pay!!
strings.item.25.548.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.548.name: HAHAHAHAHAHAHA!!
strings.item.25.549.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.549.name: It's hard to believe you're the same warrior.
strings.item.25.55.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.55.name: St...Stop it!!!
strings.item.25.550.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.550.name: I know that blast connected...
strings.item.25.551.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.551.name: This is the end...
strings.item.25.552.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.552.name: It's done.
strings.item.25.553.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.553.name: You are good... In fact, you could easily be the strongest in the universe.
strings.item.25.554.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.554.name: Hah!
strings.item.25.555.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.555.name: Still wanna go at it, huh?
strings.item.25.558.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.558.name: Agh!!
strings.item.25.559.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.559.name: Get the picture, metalheads?  Outta here or it's the scrapheap!
strings.item.25.56.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.56.name: B...But...
strings.item.25.560.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.560.name: Well, now...that wasn't half bad.
strings.item.25.561.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.561.name: Wait! No! Mercy—!
strings.item.25.563.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.563.name: I still haven't hit my stride yet!
strings.item.25.564.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.564.name: Hey, let go of me!
strings.item.25.565.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.565.name: Don't worry, I'll heal you right away!
strings.item.25.566.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.566.name: You...You did it... You actually did it!
strings.item.25.567.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.567.name: Number 13. That's your unlucky number.  And I ain't talkin' about no silly superstition.
strings.item.25.568.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.568.name: They've been destroyed?
strings.item.25.569.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.569.name: It's so tragic.
strings.item.25.570.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.570.name: Behold my perfect divinity!
strings.item.25.571.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.571.name: HAHAHAHAHAHAAH!!
strings.item.25.572.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.572.name: Whatever's going on, it can't be good...!
strings.item.25.574.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.574.name: Wow, thanks!
strings.item.25.575.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.575.name: I'm...really happy.
strings.item.25.576.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.576.name: I've never seen anyone that strong.
strings.item.25.577.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.577.name: Goodbye, my friend!
strings.item.25.579.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.579.name: I'm never fusing with you again.
strings.item.25.58.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.58.name: I can still fight!
strings.item.25.580.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.580.name: Heheheh... Aaahahahahah!
strings.item.25.581.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.581.name: Yeeeeah! This rocks!
strings.item.25.582.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.582.name: What?!
strings.item.25.583.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.583.name: Hah... Hah... Hah...
strings.item.25.584.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.584.name: RAAAAAAAAAGH!!
strings.item.25.585.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.585.name: That made me itch for a fight!
strings.item.25.586.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.586.name: This fight is effectively over.
strings.item.25.587.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.587.name: The only thing you'll be taking with you is pain.
strings.item.25.588.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.588.name: If you stay too close to Ki this powerful,  it'll burn you to a crisp.
strings.item.25.589.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.589.name: You've gotta have more left in you than that.
strings.item.25.59.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.59.name: You live up to the rumors.
strings.item.25.590.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.590.name: Look at you striking a pose like you're the top dog.
strings.item.25.592.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.592.name: Hmph.
strings.item.25.593.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.593.name: When did you learn how to do that?!
strings.item.25.594.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.594.name: Ha, I barely felt that.
strings.item.25.595.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.595.name: Sorry to burst your bubble.
strings.item.25.596.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.596.name: You really are impressive.
strings.item.25.598.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.598.name: Tell me what kind of creature you are...
strings.item.25.599.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.599.name: I've heard plenty...everything I need to know.
strings.item.25.6.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.6.name: Never faced anyone quite like you.  Now this is fun!
strings.item.25.600.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.600.name: Of course we're weak! But you can never make me ashamed of that!
strings.item.25.601.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.601.name: I can feel it... Keep it coming, you guys! Share your power with me!
strings.item.25.603.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.603.name: Looks like I've got no choice!
strings.item.25.605.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.605.name: I concede...
strings.item.25.606.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.606.name: Kamehameha!
strings.item.25.61.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.61.name: You'll eat those words!
strings.item.25.611.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.611.name: Special Beam Cannon!
strings.item.25.612.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.612.name: I got another harvest ready. You wanna buy?
strings.item.25.613.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.613.name: It seems like a ton!
strings.item.25.614.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.614.name: Quit goofin' around and find some real work!  Oh, I guess I'm not really one to talk though, am I?
strings.item.25.615.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.615.name: Gee, Krillin's not being very friendly today, is he?
strings.item.25.616.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.616.name: Heh, heh, heh...
strings.item.25.617.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.617.name: This power, I possess... It is befitting of a god.
strings.item.25.618.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.618.name: I haven't fought like this in a while. How invigorating...
strings.item.25.620.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.620.name: Heh heh.
strings.item.25.622.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.622.name: We became like friends!
strings.item.25.623.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.623.name: It looks like you're a skilled fighter in your own right.
strings.item.25.624.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.624.name: It's not like he's fighting because he wants to.
strings.item.25.625.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.625.name: Looks like everything turned out all right.
strings.item.25.627.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.627.name: Ah... Aggh...!
strings.item.25.628.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.628.name: This time, for sure...
strings.item.25.63.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.63.name: Don't give me that!
strings.item.25.630.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.630.name: Thanks for your help!
strings.item.25.631.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.631.name: I see you!
strings.item.25.632.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.632.name: Yeah, what? ...You wanna try again already?
strings.item.25.633.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.633.name: Thanks again.
strings.item.25.634.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.634.name: What are you, scared?
strings.item.25.635.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.635.name: Would you dare ignore the request of the great Hercule?!
strings.item.25.636.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.636.name: I can't believe how incredible those two are.
strings.item.25.637.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.637.name: Your rage is making you sloppy.
strings.item.25.64.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.64.name: This pain will make me stronger!
strings.item.25.640.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.640.name: What's that gigantic energy that just showed up?
strings.item.25.642.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.642.name: Grar grar!
strings.item.25.643.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.643.name: What are you going to do, huh?
strings.item.25.644.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.644.name: What?! What's going on?!
strings.item.25.645.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.645.name: Whoa, man! ...That's more power than Frieza...
strings.item.25.649.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.649.name: We are...Cooler's Armored Squadron!
strings.item.25.65.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.65.name: I'm simply a cut above the rest.
strings.item.25.650.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.650.name: They can easily be eliminated if the need arises.
strings.item.25.651.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.651.name: I trust we are all feeling a bit more cooperative now, yes?
strings.item.25.652.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.652.name: I'm disappointed—that was weak!
strings.item.25.653.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.653.name: Answer me this: why would you turn against Lord Frieza?
strings.item.25.656.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.656.name: You want to know what your big mistake was?
strings.item.25.657.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.657.name: You feel the power in those Saiyan cells, but you don't truly understand it because you didn't build it! And you'll never learn to think like that clown!
strings.item.25.658.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.658.name: I'm funny. I'm sure you gathered from my clever little rhyme there...
strings.item.25.659.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.659.name: You're good, Saiyan, but that's not going to save you today!
strings.item.25.66.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.66.name: I was still powerless!
strings.item.25.660.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.660.name: Is the reality of your fate setting in?
strings.item.25.661.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.661.name: Keep on laughing. It'll be your undoing!
strings.item.25.662.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.662.name: This dragon is in a league of his own. You have no idea.
strings.item.25.664.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.664.name: At long last, I've ascended.
strings.item.25.666.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.666.name: I am they. We are one. Unfortunately for you.
strings.item.25.67.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.67.name: Heh.
strings.item.25.68.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.68.name: Heh heh!
strings.item.25.69.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.69.name: Hey, calm down!
strings.item.25.7.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.7.name: Your skills are skyrocketing.
strings.item.25.70.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.70.name: Don't follow orders from  people who want to use you!
strings.item.25.71.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.71.name: Did you bring Senzu Beans?
strings.item.25.72.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.72.name: This is no time to mess around...
strings.item.25.73.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.73.name: Brilliant!
strings.item.25.74.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.74.name: Let's take this match from the top!
strings.item.25.75.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.75.name: Ehh?
strings.item.25.76.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.76.name: *sob* *sob*
strings.item.25.77.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.78.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.78.name: You...can't... do...this!!
strings.item.25.79.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.79.name: Thanks!
strings.item.25.8.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.8.name: So you're not all talk, are you?
strings.item.25.80.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.80.name: That was it. Our last hope... It's over.
strings.item.25.81.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.81.name: My, my... All grown up, aren't we.
strings.item.25.82.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.82.name: Yeah, that's what I'm talking about!
strings.item.25.83.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.83.name: But you still haven't shown me you can use this upgrade to pack a decent punch.
strings.item.25.85.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.85.name: Haha! I'm not like your former opponents, am I?
strings.item.25.86.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.86.name: Don't be stubborn now!
strings.item.25.88.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*With voice
strings.item.25.88.name: Shall I eat you as well?
strings.item.25.89.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.89.name: What's going on...?
strings.item.25.9.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.9.name: You're stronger than I thought. I'm surprised.
strings.item.25.90.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.90.name: No...!!!
strings.item.25.91.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.91.name: Heh heh heh... The great day is finally here...
strings.item.25.92.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.92.name: Hmph, don't be foolish. It's a great honor to be fuel for my power.
strings.item.25.93.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.93.name: Curse...you...!!!
strings.item.25.94.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.94.name: He had that much power buried in him?!
strings.item.25.95.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.95.name: This is your last chance to say goodbye.
strings.item.25.96.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.96.name: That was one weird dream.
strings.item.25.97.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.97.name: I will defeat you!
strings.item.25.98.detail:
Item to increase message limit.
*Without voice
strings.item.25.98.name: Thanks!
